**Computation (FY2024, year ended June 30, 2024):**

- Revenue: $245,122 million [DOC-1: "Fiscal year ended June 30, 2024: Revenue $245,122; Cost of revenue $74,114."]
- Cost of revenue: $74,114 million [DOC-1: "Fiscal year ended June 30, 2024: Revenue $245,122; Cost of revenue $74,114."]
- Gross margin (gross profit) = $245,122M − $74,114M = **$171,008 million**
- Gross margin percentage = $171,008M ÷ $245,122M = **69.8%**

**Comparability note:** This figure is drawn from a single fiscal period within one filing, so no cross-period, cross-entity, or cross-basis comparability issue arises. (For context only, the same filing reports FY2023 revenue of $211,915M and cost of revenue of $65,863M [DOC-1: "Fiscal year ended June 30, 2023 (prior-year comparative): Revenue $211,915; Cost of revenue $65,863."], implying a FY2023 gross margin of $146,052M, or 68.9% — these prior-year amounts are presented on a comparative basis in the FY2024 10-K and are directly comparable.)

ANSWER: $171,008 million gross profit, or approximately 69.8% of revenue
